title: Zeolite-confined subnanometric PtSn mimicking mortise-and-tenon joinery for catalytic propane dehydrogenation
extraction_notes: No in-scope experimental propane dehydrogenation catalyst-performance records were found in this paper. The reported PDH activities (e.g., TOF values for Pt6Sn2@MFI and Pt3Sn surfaces at 773 K and 1 bar propane) are from DFT/microkinetic simulations, which are out of scope. The only experimental rate mentioned (3.5 mol C3H6 per mol Pt s-1) is cited from ref. 7/literature, not measured in this paper, and was not extracted.
